title: Newer Realtek Wi-Fi firmware (rtw88)
summary: A newer version of the RTL8821C, RTL8822B and RTL8822C firmware than the one in the system, with Realtek's fixes since.
description: Phoenix comes with this firmware; this is a newer release from linux-firmware. It is installed beside the system's (in /lib/firmware/updates, which the kernel reads first), so removing it goes back to the system's.
